description: This file declares the ScriptTypeParser class which is responsible for parsing expressions into types and schema in the PyTorch JIT frontend. It provides functions for parsing types from expressions, strings, and schema definitions, as well as handling class constants and default argument evaluations.
external_methods: FunctionSchema parseSchemaFromDef(const Def& def, bool skip_self)

classes.name: ScriptTypeParser
classes.description: Responsible for parsing expressions into types, schemas, and constants within the JIT frontend. It offers multiple methods for parsing type information from different sources and handles internal utilities such as evaluating default arguments.

methods.name: ScriptTypeParser
methods.description: Constructor accepting a Resolver pointer, used to resolve symbols during parsing.

methods.name: parseTypeFromExpr
methods.description: Parses a type expression from an AST node.

methods.name: parseBroadcastList
methods.description: Parses a broadcast list from an expression, returning a pair of type and integer.

methods.name: parseType
methods.description: Parses a type from its string representation.

methods.name: parseSchemaFromDef
methods.description: Parses a function schema from a definition node, optionally skipping 'self'.

methods.name: parseClassConstant
methods.description: Parses a class constant from an assignment expression.
